title: Biorepository Laboratory
objective: Complete biorepository workflow from sample intake to long-term storage and disposition
content: Biorepository Laboratory notebook template with 7 predefined workflow pages for sample intake, storage, monitoring, retention, requests, QC inspection, and reporting.

pages.title: Sample Intake
pages.instructions: Register incoming biological samples for long-term storage. Capture complete metadata including sample origin, donor information (if applicable), sample type, volume/quantity, collection date, receiving date, study/project linkage, and consent documentation reference. Assign biorepository ID and generate barcodes.
pages.content: Sample Intake - Biological sample registration and accession

pages.title: Storage Assignment
pages.instructions: Assign samples to appropriate long-term storage locations. Use hierarchical location system (Room -> Device/Freezer -> Shelf -> Rack -> Box -> Well/Position). Select storage conditions based on sample type.
pages.content: Storage Assignment - Physical location assignment and storage manifest generation

pages.title: Environmental Monitoring
pages.instructions: Monitor and record storage conditions continuously. Log temperature readings (continuous monitoring or manual AM/PM checks) for all storage units. Record any temperature excursions with response actions taken. Document equipment maintenance events (defrost cycles, malfunctions, repairs). Generate environmental monitoring reports.
pages.content: Environmental Monitoring - Temperature and condition monitoring for all storage units

pages.title: Retention & Disposal
pages.instructions: Manage sample retention periods and execute disposal. Apply material-specific retention policies (clinical: per consent/protocol, research: per MTA/protocol, reference: indefinite). Process disposal of expired or exhausted samples using approved methods (autoclave, incineration, chemical treatment). Document all disposal events with supervisor authorization.
pages.content: Retention & Disposal - Sample lifecycle management and compliant disposal

pages.title: Sample Request
pages.instructions: Process requests for stored samples from authorized researchers or clinical teams. Review request authorization, consent compliance, and available quantity. Record requestor details, purpose, MTA/agreement reference, samples requested, and approved quantity. Track aliquot creation and shipment for outgoing samples.
pages.content: Sample Request - Authorized sample retrieval and distribution management

pages.title: QC Inspection
pages.instructions: Perform periodic quality control inspections of stored samples. Visually inspect sample integrity (tube integrity, label legibility, ice crystal formation). Verify location accuracy against database records. Check for any cross-contamination risks. Document inspection findings and corrective actions for any discrepancies.
pages.content: QC Inspection - Periodic sample integrity and location verification

pages.title: Reporting
pages.instructions: Generate biorepository utilization and compliance reports. Track inventory levels, inflow/outflow trends, storage capacity utilization, and sample age distribution. Generate regulatory compliance reports (temperature excursion history, disposal records). Provide inventory reports for sponsors and regulatory authorities.
pages.content: Reporting - Inventory, utilization, and compliance reporting
